label: Hypnotized in bed — all-media search (26 Nov 2026)
group_title: Adult woman hypnotized while in bed
description: All-media pass (26 Nov 2026 PT) for adult women who are hypnotized while lying or sitting on a bed (in bed at night, asleep in bed, in a hospital bed), forced hypnosis included. Excluded: men-only scenes, possession, magic spells and potions, drugs-only control, implanted devices, and minors or children's and teen shows. No new title qualified that was not already in the catalog, so existing cards are tagged 'hypnotized in bed' rather than duplicated. The bed detail comes from each cited source.
